Bill.BriefDescription: Prohibiting purchase or sale of human body parts for research purposes.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to purchase or sale of human body parts; andamending RCW 68.50.610.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 68.50.610 and 2003 c 53 s 312 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A person may not knowingly, for valuable consideration,purchase or sell a part for transplantation, research, or therapy, ifremoval of the part is intended to occur after the death of thedecedent. (2) Valuable consideration does not include reasonable payment forthe removal, processing, disposal, preservation, quality control,storage, transportation, or implantation of a part. (3) A person who violates this section is guilty of a class Cfelony and upon conviction is subject to a fine not exceeding fiftythousand dollars or imprisonment not exceeding five years, or both.
